# OSDConfig

> **File:** `config/OSDConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the OSD section (the volume, microphone and brightness on-screen displays). Named OSDConfig because `OSD` is the module type.

### Properties

- `scrollStep` (readonly real): Level change per wheel notch (0-1); 0 when scrolling is off
- `osds` (readonly var)
- `shownIds` (readonly var): The enabled ones, by id: what the shell builds
- `excludedApps` (readonly var): The streams the App bars of every OSD match, which the Other apps bars skip

### Functions

- `osdById(id)`
- `labelOf(osd)`: The name on its tab: its own, else its bars'
